name: Service Agreement
description: A contract between a service provider and a client defining the scope, terms, and payment for services rendered.
content:
SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{effective_date}} between:

{{provider_name}}, located at {{provider_address}} ("Service Provider"),

and

{{client_name}}, located at {{client_address}} ("Client").

1. SERVICES
The Service Provider agrees to perform the following services for the Client:

{{services_description}}

2. DELIVERABLES
The Service Provider shall deliver the following:

{{deliverables}}

3. PROJECT TIMELINE
Services shall commence on {{project_start_date}} and are expected to be completed by {{project_end_date}}, subject to any amendments agreed in writing by both parties.

4. FEES AND PAYMENT
The Client shall pay the Service Provider a total fee of {{fee_amount}} {{fee_currency}} in accordance with the following schedule:

{{payment_schedule}}

Invoices are due within 30 days of issuance. Late payments shall accrue interest at a rate of {{late_payment_interest_rate}}% per month on the outstanding balance.

5. EXPENSES
The Client shall reimburse the Service Provider for all pre-approved, reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred in connection with the services, provided receipts are submitted.

6. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR
The Service Provider is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner, or agent of the Client. The Service Provider is solely responsible for all taxes, insurance, and other obligations arising from its status as an independent contractor.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
Upon receipt of full payment, all work product and deliverables created specifically for the Client under this Agreement shall become the sole property of the Client. The Service Provider retains ownership of all pre-existing intellectual property and tools used in performing the services.

8. CONFIDENTIALITY
Both parties agree to keep confidential any proprietary or sensitive information exchanged in the course of this Agreement and not to disclose it to third parties without prior written consent.

9. WARRANTIES
The Service Provider warrants that:
a) The services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner;
b) The deliverables will be original and will not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights.

10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
In no event shall either party be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages. The Service Provider's total liability shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement.

11. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 14 days' written notice. Upon termination, the Client shall pay for all services rendered and expenses incurred up to the termination date.

12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall first be attempted to be resolved through good-faith negotiation. If unresolved within 30 days, disputes shall be submitted to binding arbitration.

13. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of {{governing_law_state}}.

14. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, or agreements relating to the subject matter herein.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

_______________________________

Service Provider
